'''Shenio Mining''' was a mining company that enlisted the aid of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in liberating [[Gaftikar]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in order to get to the planet's [[Kelerium/Legends|kelerium]] and [[norax]] deposits.
